decisions.title: Bind outcomes to authenticated scope and full proposals (R06)
decisions.deliverable: Versioned receipt/verification ADR and v1 compatibility proposal.
decisions.acceptance: Reject foreign scope/authority and different requests sharing ID, type, sequence and time; exact retries retain identity.
decisions.needed_inputs: Authority trust/key-distribution model and transport envelope choice; distinguish outcome receipts from donor consent receipts.

decisions.title: Make identifier and canonical-map domains agree (R10)
decisions.deliverable: Identifier-domain or map-encoding ADR, inventory of affected IDs and migration fixtures.
decisions.acceptance: Every permitted ID round-trips and replays; unsafe IDs fail before mutation; no silent renaming of signed history.
decisions.needed_inputs: Compatibility requirements for persisted v1 records and all proposed graph identifiers.

decisions.title: Authenticate genesis for standalone import/rebuild (R12)
decisions.deliverable: Versioned genesis commitment or authenticated import-manifest design.
decisions.acceptance: Changing any initial actor/item/balance/party/clock/seed under an unchanged event head fails authenticated import.
decisions.needed_inputs: Trust source for imported genesis; legacy-history anchoring and private seed handling.

decisions.title: Choose storage rollback and recovery assurance (R13)
decisions.deliverable: Explicit storage trust/restore ADR; independent monotonic-anchor protocol if that assurance is selected.
decisions.acceptance: If selected, reject pre-revocation prefix/whole-directory rollback and conflicting heads; define checkpoint-unavailable and append/checkpoint crash behavior.
decisions.needed_inputs: Threat model, backup/restore objectives, availability tradeoffs and independent checkpoint owner. Another file in the same rollback domain is insufficient.

decisions.title: Specify two-plane storage and temporal/query semantics
decisions.deliverable: Storage ADR and v1-to-proposed temporal mapping: valid time, recorded sequence, acquisition and shared projection checkpoints.
decisions.acceptance: Worked delayed/equal-tick/correction timelines have unambiguous answers; unscoped, foreign, future-acquired and mixed-prefix reads fail.
decisions.needed_inputs: Target workload, store separation, transaction/cursor strategy, rebuild/recovery needs and pinned source delta evidence. SQLite is a candidate, not an established gameplay store.

decisions.title: Define expedition/session world-time and disclosure delivery
decisions.deliverable: Clock-driving, solo/raid checkpoint and delivery-to-epistemic-commit protocol.
decisions.acceptance: Pause/retry/reorder/cancellation do not silently advance time, duplicate observations or merge private facts; each supported conflict mode has deterministic behavior.
decisions.needed_inputs: Supported release modes, real-time cadence/catch-up policy, what counts as heard/observed and fork return policy if forks are selected.

decisions.title: Bind identity, rights and consent at live service boundaries
decisions.acceptance: Forged actor/tenant/right claims, cache crossover and narrator-made consent fail at runtime; disclosure is rechecked at delivery.
decisions.needed_inputs: Identity provider, content entitlements, receipt provenance and key/custody operations. Mandatory JSON fields alone are not authentication.

decisions.title: Select a source-pinned licensed rules kernel
decisions.deliverable: Edition-specific material/license/attribution decision and minimal ruleset scope.
decisions.acceptance: Selected rule bytes and license are hashed and reviewed; executable examples reproduce rules; excluded setting/art/product material stays excluded.
decisions.needed_inputs: Exact rule text and redistribution/adaptation terms; Knave1e remains provisional, with no Knave2e inheritance.

decisions.title: Connect application verification to board acceptance safely
decisions.deliverable: Reviewed external gate/receipt protocol and a single owner of Git integration/recovery.
decisions.acceptance: A worker cannot forge success; receipts bind exact candidate/tree/policy/base; timeout, stale base, crash/recovery and artifact handoff are deterministic.
decisions.needed_inputs: Choose how board and separately trusted controller coordinate; do not execute arbitrary application imports inside the data-validator oracle.

decisions.title: Specify deterministic background simulation budgets
decisions.deliverable: Discrete tick, RNG slot, scheduling and resource-budget design.
decisions.acceptance: Identical seed/events yield identical proposals/effects; rejected/empty proposals have no side effects; backlog and resource use are bounded.
decisions.needed_inputs: Selected simulation granularity and budgets. Starter R3 cadence/caps are hypotheses, not measured production limits.

decisions.title: Define the first playable world and content provenance
decisions.deliverable: Playable scope/world-seed manifest and import policy.
decisions.acceptance: Every entity/item/faction/source has explicit scope, origin and rights; imported material cannot grant authority or silently become canon.
decisions.needed_inputs: Chosen world, session modes, ruleset and licensed/homebrew assets. The supplied scenario is an integration slice, not a populated general sandbox.

work_items.title: Refresh exact source/storage delta evidence
work_items.deliverable: Verified source bundle references, API/table/edge/encryption/tenant and async capability-gap matrix.
work_items.acceptance: Every reuse claim names a pinned file/symbol/hash; unavailable source remains explicit; no legacy database or repository mutation.

work_items.title: Pin mechanics, license evidence and adversarial fixtures
work_items.deliverable: Evidence-backed timeline/rumor/tick/session examples, selected license/source bytes and benchmark fixtures.
work_items.acceptance: Separate source claims from hypotheses; retain provenance and edition-specific grants; do not label proposals as executed benchmarks.

work_items.title: Freeze reviewed projection/query contracts
work_items.deliverable: Versioned proposal/migration and negative fixtures for graph records, scoped queries, cursors and common checkpoints.
work_items.acceptance: Schema conformance plus runtime negative tests reject foreign/unscoped/mixed-prefix/future-acquired views; v1 remains readable under explicit compatibility.

work_items.title: Implement reviewed authority/history migrations
work_items.deliverable: Versioned receipt, identifier and authenticated-history changes; selected rollback protocol or explicit bounded trust model.
work_items.acceptance: Cross-scope receipt and changed-genesis import fail; old histories retain defined replay; selected restore guarantees are tested before reliance.

work_items.title: Build canonical Plane A projector
work_items.deliverable: Deterministic entity/edge/custody/clock projection with a durable prefix cursor.
work_items.acceptance: Rebuild and incremental results match at every sampled prefix; direct agent writes are impossible through public APIs; crash/restart cannot advance cursor past durable state.

work_items.title: Build epistemic Plane B and scoped reads
work_items.deliverable: Actor-scoped claim/rumor/observation/provenance index and a projection-backed LEXI adapter.
work_items.acceptance: Private-to-party, rights-lane and future-acquisition leakage fail; contradictory accounts coexist without replacing canon; replay preserves disclosure.

work_items.title: Prove shared-checkpoint replay at scale
work_items.deliverable: Common-checkpoint integration and a seeded 10,000-event workload with retained failing traces.
work_items.acceptance: Sampled-prefix rebuilds equal incremental state and both graph hashes; custody contention, rumors, disclosures and authorized clock jumps are covered.

work_items.title: Integrate the bounded component bus
work_items.deliverable: Versioned message delivery/acknowledgement, durable cursors and bounded retry/backpressure through the authority boundary.
work_items.acceptance: Duplicate/reordered delivery, lag, cancellation and stale heads cannot double-apply actions or mix views; delivery uncertainty is reconciled by identity.

work_items.title: Add optional NPC and intervention loops
work_items.deliverable: Separate bounded principals consuming authorized views/triggers and submitting optional proposals.
work_items.acceptance: No direct ledger/graph writes, forced quests, fabricated consent or hidden-roll disclosure; empty/rejected proposals leave canon unchanged.

work_items.title: Pass headless solo/raid and concurrency acceptance
work_items.deliverable: End-to-end headless checkpoints, explicit disclosures and failure/recovery workloads.
work_items.acceptance: Race contention has deterministic results; solo secrets stay private; no zombie effects; seeded replay and Tempted Fates cutoff/jurisdiction tests remain green.

work_items.title: Provide authenticated services and operational recovery
work_items.deliverable: Real domain transports, principal/entitlement/consent enforcement, key operations, backups and selected restore guarantees.
work_items.acceptance: Authenticated integration tests enforce scope and rights end-to-end; backup/restore drills meet the selected trust model; unavailable services fail closed.

work_items.title: Add the selected licensed ruleset adapter
work_items.deliverable: Implementation of the independently reviewed ruleset extension/registry and source-pinned minimal kernel, retaining Tempted Fates compatibility.
work_items.acceptance: Deterministic rule fixtures and replay pass; attribution is retained; no new fields or state model are invented outside contract review.

work_items.title: Build player-facing session/narration then voice
work_items.deliverable: Intent/session coordinator over rulings and scoped views; text interaction first, voice after turn/cancellation/disclosure semantics pass.
work_items.acceptance: Prose cannot mutate truth; partial speech and interruptions cannot invent knowledge or consent; actor visibility and anomaly cutoffs survive live turns.

work_items.title: Implement the reviewed board application adapter
work_items.deliverable: External application verification/recovery integration, fresh immutable seed/policy and real handoff fixtures.
work_items.acceptance: Altered/stale/forged receipts and early exits fail; crash/recovery yields one real merge and accepted CAS handoff; no self-grading.

work_items.title: Enable operational worker dispatch only after readiness
work_items.deliverable: Reviewed semantic oracles and immutable dependency/path scopes; credential/capacity/cancellation policy for any future provider dispatch.
work_items.acceptance: Audit/synthesis/architecture gates no longer return GATE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; zombie/429/lease loss and quotas are tested; explicit paid-run authorization is separately required.

work_items.title: Prepare a rights-scoped playable world seed
work_items.deliverable: Validated, provenance-bearing world seed and content ingestion fixtures compatible with the chosen ruleset.
work_items.acceptance: No private/licensed context bleed or imported privilege grants; seed identity and rights are verified; no mandatory storyline or automatic anomaly-farming trigger.

work_items.title: Review the licensed ruleset contract extension
work_items.deliverable: A separate versioned ruleset extension proposal covering required state/action fields, registry interface, units and v1 history compatibility.
work_items.acceptance: Exact licensed rule fixtures map to defined contracts; old Tempted Fates histories retain defined replay; no unreviewed fields or lane-local state models.

notes: Planning dependencies are acceptance prerequisites, not permission to start paid workers.
Decision and work-item statuses describe future work; ready_for_design is not ready_for_implementation.
Contract and shared-package ownership must be serialized even where design lanes are independent.
Existing Tempted Fates actions suffice for projection tests; a new licensed ruleset is not their prerequisite.
R06/R12/R13 block their specific remote receipt, authenticated import and rollback assurances, not all local projection exploration.
